olivia: Heads up — need a tiny dedicated GPU alloc for tomorrow's in-office demo. It's an embedded LLM (7B quant) that needs low p99 latency. Can we carve from eu-west1 pool? Also procurement asked if this should be bill-as-hosted or reserved (need invoice flag).

jamal: Quick q — what's peak concurrent workers and typical sequence length? We can either carve a short-lived dedicated slot or try burst on hosted.

irene: Demo details: 3 concurrent clients, seq ~512, about a 30-minute run. Internal only (PM + Eng runthrough).

jamal: Ok 3x7B-quant is doable. I'll check eu-west1 standby right now.

jamal: ```
$ rctl gpu list --region eu-west1 --sku a500,a100,h100
region eu-west1
standby: 4 free (a500:2, a100:1, h100:1)
reserved_windows: 0600-1000 UTC
``` 

jamal: I can provision 1 a500 warm slot and pin the model as a short-lived dedicated-lite instance. Cost-wise this would default to Dedicated (procurement) unless you want to bill-as-hosted. @procurement thoughts?

procurement: For <=24h ad-hoc demo reserves we typically bill-as-hosted to avoid PO churn. If you need an invoice/PO for customer-facing events we can switch to reserved and emit an invoice. For internal demos, please use cost-center "internal-ops" unless told otherwise.

olivia: @procurement prefer hosted billing for this (no PO). Please tag cost-center internal-ops. :thumbsup:

jamal: Got it. I'll create a one-off pool label demo/olivia-1709876543, route traffic there and run a quick canary+smoke. ETA ~12m. I'll also warm KV cache to avoid first-token spikes.

oncall-bot: Deploy job #4821 queued — running prechecks.

oncall-bot: Deploy job #4821 status: smoke tests running.

jamal: Smoke passed. Note: warm the model with 3 short prefix requests once the slot is live:

jamal: ```
# warmup (run 3 sequential requests ~128 tokens)
for i in 1 2 3; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://redwood-inference/internal/generate \
    -d '{"model":"embedded-7b-quant","prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":128}'
done
```

devex: I'll add that warmup script to the demo checklist and paste the calendar invite with connection info.

olivia: Perfect — thanks everyone. Will update the invite and send the runbook link.
